introduction: Oklahoma TANF provides temporary cash and employment-related support to qualifying families with minor children. Apply through OKDHSLive to begin the review.
description: Oklahoma TANF provides temporary cash and employment-related support to qualifying families with minor children. Apply through OKDHSLive to begin the review.

sections.who: The state considers responsibility for a child in the home, income and status requirements. Child-support cooperation and a personalized TANF Work Plan are part of the listed conditions.
sections.get: Eligible families can receive temporary cash, employment preparation and related support. The agency page also identifies qualifying child-care assistance.
sections.docs:
• Household and child information.
  • Income records and requested status proof.
  • Social Security information for people included in the benefit.
sections.apply:
1. Apply through OKDHSLive

    Use the state TANF page to reach the application.

  2. Complete the case assessment

    Answer requests about finances, caregiving and the child’s circumstances.

  3. Review your plan

    Ask how work-plan and child-support requirements apply and raise any safety or participation concern.
sections.after: Read the award and participation instructions. Keep records of required activities and ask the worker how a change in work or caregiving should be reported.
sections.sources: Checked October 1, 2026 using TANF eligibility, services and application. USA Assistance background guide. Program staff determine eligibility and available assistance.

faqs: Must a child live with me?
The state lists responsibility for a minor child living in the home as a requirement.
The program also describes job-readiness and related family support.
Where can I ask a program question?
The TANF page lists 866-411-1877 and TANF@okdhs.org.

provenance.scope: Published eligibility, service purpose and application pathway; no unverified financial limits or deadlines included.
